configuration.integrator: explicit Euler in shared P,v state
configuration.x_stencil: fourth-order central D1, D2=D1 composed with D1
configuration.state: P=delta_minus u and physical v, identical initial state for all routes
configuration.reference: continuous exact solution, unchanged physical a and common boundary
configuration.boundary: analytic left base/ghost, right ghost extrapolates perturbation quadratically relative to common exact background
configuration.evaluation: Linf on fixed y nodes in (-1.5,1.5), x in [-10,10), x interpolation to 4nx checked against 8nx
configuration.scope: deterministic short-time comparison, no long-time or statistical claim
